case_title: FLEMI VS EUGENE'S AUTO BODY SHOP

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $700.00 FILED BY FLEMI AS TO DEFENDANT EUGENE'S AUTO BODY SHOP ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-25-1996 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT C
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERT MAIL TO EUGENE'S AUTO BODY SHOP, OWNER EUGENE RETURNED SIGNED.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FLEMI IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT EUGENE'S AUTO BODY SHOP STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
